summary: Fix the Watch Poster Shelf horizontal balance defect visible in Owner Production. Keep the accepted Poster Shelf geometry and poster sizes, but stop left-packing fixed-width poster tracks; distribute the existing auto-fill tracks across the full content width so the first and last tracks align to the same content box while incomplete final rows stay on the same track system. Shared Shell, Navigation and frozen Channels remain unchanged. No data model, schema, migration or updater change. Production remains Owner manual.
